description: Targeting-signal scan across 371 vertebrate ADPRHL1 orthologs and the three human ARH paralogs
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, re, requests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def fasta(acc):
    return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
HUM = {'ADPRHL1 (Q8NDY3)':fasta('Q8NDY3'),'ADPRH/ARH1 (P54922)':fasta('P54922'),'ADPRHL2/ARH3 (Q9NX46)':fasta('Q9NX46')}
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
    params={"query":"(gene:ADPRHL1) AND (taxonomy_id:7742)","size":500,
            "fields":"accession,organism_name,length,sequence","format":"json"},timeout=120).json()["results"]
orth=pd.DataFrame([dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"],org=e["organism"]["scientificName"],
                        length=e["sequence"]["length"],seq=e["sequence"]["value"]) for e in r])
orth=orth.sort_values(["org","length"],ascending=[True,False]).drop_duplicates("org").reset_index(drop=True)

KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,
        K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
def kd_prof(s,w=19):
    v=np.array([KD.get(c,0) for c in s])
    return np.convolve(v,np.ones(w)/w,mode='valid') if len(v)>=w else np.array([v.mean()])
sig2=re.compile(r'GD[AC][LVM]G[YSF]')
def core_offset(s):
    m=sig2.search(s[:90]); return m.start()+1 if m else np.nan
def nterm_feats(s,n=30):
    seg=s[:n]
    return dict(acidic=sum(c in 'DE' for c in seg), basic=sum(c in 'KR' for c in seg),
                netQ=sum(c in 'KR' for c in seg)-sum(c in 'DE' for c in seg),
                meanKD=float(np.mean([KD.get(c,0) for c in seg])), maxKD19=float(kd_prof(s).max()),
                core_pos=core_offset(s))

orth2=pd.concat([orth.drop(columns='seq'), pd.DataFrame([nterm_feats(s) for s in orth.seq])],axis=1)
hf=pd.DataFrame({k:nterm_feats(v) for k,v in HUM.items()}).T

print(f"ADPRHL1 orthologs: {len(orth2)} species, {int(orth2.core_pos.notna().sum())} with detectable ARH core motif")
print("\nARH core-motif start (median across orthologs): %.0f  | range %.0f-%.0f"
      % (orth2.core_pos.median(), orth2.core_pos.min(), orth2.core_pos.max()))
print("\nHuman paralogs, N-terminal 30 aa:")
print(hf.round(3).to_string())
print("\nOrtholog N-terminal 30 aa summary:")
print(orth2[['length','core_pos','acidic','basic','netQ','meanKD','maxKD19']].describe().round(2).to_string())
print("\nMTS-compatible N-termini (0 acidic residues in first 30): %d/%d (%.1f%%)"
      % ((orth2.acidic==0).sum(), len(orth2), 100*(orth2.acidic==0).mean()))
print("Classic MTS pattern (0 acidic AND netQ>=+3):", int(((orth2.acidic==0)&(orth2.netQ>=3)).sum()))
print("TM segment predicted anywhere (max KD19 > 1.6):", int((orth2.maxKD19>1.6).sum()),
      "| median max KD19 = %.2f" % orth2.maxKD19.median())
print("Signal-peptide-compatible (meanKD of 1-30 > +0.5):", int((orth2.meanKD>0.5).sum()))

# ---------------- figure ----------------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(13,9))
colors={'ADPRHL1 (Q8NDY3)':'#2F6DB5','ADPRH/ARH1 (P54922)':'#2E9E7E','ADPRHL2/ARH3 (Q9NX46)':'#C4553B'}
ax=axes[0,0]
for k,v in HUM.items():
    p=kd_prof(v); ax.plot(np.arange(len(p))+10,p,label=k.split(' (')[0],color=colors[k],lw=1.6)
ax.axhline(1.6,ls='--',c='k',lw=1); ax.text(5,1.65,'TM threshold (KD19 = 1.6)',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('Residue'); ax.set_ylabel('Kyte-Doolittle, 19-aa window')
ax.set_title('No window reaches the transmembrane threshold in any ARH paralog',fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)

ax=axes[0,1]
for k,v in HUM.items():
    cs=np.cumsum([1 if c in 'KR' else (-1 if c in 'DE' else 0) for c in v[:60]])
    ax.plot(np.arange(1,61),cs,color=colors[k],lw=1.8,label=k.split(' (')[0])
    cp=core_offset(v); ax.axvline(cp,color=colors[k],ls=':',lw=1.2)
ax.axhline(0,c='grey',lw=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel('Residue'); ax.set_ylabel('Cumulative net charge')
ax.set_title('ARH3 alone has an acidic-free basic N-extension\n(dotted lines = start of ARH catalytic core motif)',fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)

ax=axes[1,0]
ax.hist(orth2.acidic.dropna(),bins=np.arange(-0.5,9,1),color='#2F6DB5',edgecolor='w')
ax.axvline(hf.loc['ADPRHL2/ARH3 (Q9NX46)','acidic'],color='#C4553B',lw=2,label='human ARH3 = 0 (MTS)')
ax.axvline(hf.loc['ADPRHL1 (Q8NDY3)','acidic'],color='k',lw=2,ls='--',label='human ADPRHL1 = 3')
ax.set_xlabel('Acidic residues (D+E) in N-terminal 30 aa')
ax.set_ylabel('ADPRHL1 orthologs')
ax.set_title(f'{len(orth2)} vertebrate ADPRHL1 orthologs: N-termini carry acidic\nresidues, which mitochondrial presequences exclude',fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)

ax=axes[1,1]
ax.hist(orth2.core_pos.dropna(),bins=np.arange(9.5,40,1),color='#2E9E7E',edgecolor='w')
ax.axvline(hf.loc['ADPRHL2/ARH3 (Q9NX46)','core_pos'],color='#C4553B',lw=2,label='human ARH3 = 33')
ax.axvline(hf.loc['ADPRHL1 (Q8NDY3)','core_pos'],color='k',lw=2,ls='--',label='human ADPRHL1 = 14')
ax.set_xlabel('Start of ARH catalytic core motif GD[AC][LVM]G[YSF]')
ax.set_ylabel('ADPRHL1 orthologs')
ax.set_title('ADPRHL1 orthologs have no N-terminal extension\nbefore the ARH fold; ARH3 has ~19 extra residues',fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
globals()['ORTH2']=orth2
